Thanks Ben — quick problem: the calendar invite arrived but the 'Join with Google Meet' button shows our org as the organizer (we're seeing a 'guest access restricted' error) and none of our team can actually join. We use strict SSO on Meet and sometimes external organizer invites get blocked unless the organizer is within the same Google Workspace.

salesops@ardentapps.com is managing the calendar — would you be able to resend as a Zoom link or create an alternate Zoom join URL?

Also, could you resend the .ics rather than relying on the original invite (some of our attendees are using Outlook and the original invite isn't parsing correctly).

Appreciate it — Emma
Director of Product, Ardent Apps

Hi Emma — sorry for the friction here and thanks for the details.

I can reproduce the issue in a test tenant: when a Redwood calendar invite uses our Google-organizer identity, some Google Workspace orgs treat the invite as an external organizer and deny guest join. We should avoid that for Ardent Apps.

Plan:
1) Ben — please hold the original Meet invite.
2) Priyom — can you generate a temporary Zoom meeting (no SSO required) and produce a regenerated .ics with that Zoom join URL embedded? I put Priyom on the thread to action the alt link and the new .ics.
3) Ben — once Priyom shares the Zoom URL and .ics, resend to Emma/salesops and include the rescheduled/resend ICS as an attachment so Outlook users get the proper file.

I've attached a quick internal checklist we use for cross-tenant demos (attachment: invite-debug-checklist.txt) — it calls out organizer SSO edge cases.

Emma — apologies again. We'll get an alt Zoom link and resend the proper invite within the hour.

Best,
